title: Internal hom into a quasicategory
statement: Use simplicial sets and internal functor objects as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For every small simplicial set $A$ and quasicategory $X$ in the fixed sufficiently large universe, $\operatorname{Fun}(A,X)$ is a quasicategory.

source.place: Lecture II, basic fact (1), printed p.14; internal-hom statement without additional mapping-space/core clauses.
